contracts.description: Material changes preserve an identifiable previous state and restoration path.
Material changes declare a Change Envelope; unmentioned behavior, contracts, data and configuration remain unchanged.

verification.required_evidence: ADAPTAR: envelope and focused regression evidence

contracts.description: Critical external effects require scoped authority bound to the action and revision.
Applicable quality attributes are measurable scenarios with fresh evidence.
Environments isolate exposure, data, credentials and cost controls.
Paid services have measurement, budgets, alerts, quotas and application containment.
Material runs declare model routing and compute ceilings; unavailable usage is never zero.
Persistent services have approved RTO/RPO and fresh restore evidence.
RTO/RPO evolution uses the maximum exposure ratio across people, operations, economic value and data while preserving safety floors.
The APOS Kernel remains compact and contains authority, preservation, safety floors, completion, evidence and economics.
Material runs compile the smallest sufficient authoritative context and record a ContextManifest.
Context domains resolve in the Epistemic Registry with sources, methods, uncertainties, relationships, owner and refresh triggers.
Every material Intent selects Lite, Standard or Strict from the worst applicable risk dimension.
Material runs record context, output, calls, time, rework, regressions and reused Evidence per step.
